L48: # Wahoo! See the platforming history of Super Mario (and even get a few fun facts!)
L49: 
L50: Cheerful, inspiring, and one heck of a jumper, Mario has bravely faced all kinds of challenges over the decades. While some folks may have first met him during his plumber era, Mario has since taken on many different roles to help keep his friends and the Mushroom Kingdom safe.
L51: Whether you met Mario as a plumber or an elephant with a mustache, you may be looking to learn a bit more about his super adventures. So, we’ve gathered a few fun facts below to salute our red-capped champ. You can share them with your friends and family to get them into the “Wahoo!” spirit.
L52: 
L53: 【33†Image†assets.nintendo.com】
L54: ## Let’s-a go to the facts!
L55: 
L56:   * Mario was created by Mr. Shigeru Miyamoto and went by the name “Jumpman” in the Donkey Kong™ arcade game (1981). Mr. Miyamoto originally named him “Mr. Video” and wanted to put that character in all the games that he made.
L57: 
L58:   * The original Mario was a 16 x 16 pixelated image. This technical restriction brought about some of his iconic features: for example, he was given white gloves to make his movements easier to spot when he jumped.
L59:   * The first Super Mario Bros.™ game was designed on graph paper.
L60: 
L61:   * One of Mario’s most iconic power-ups is the Super Mushroom, but he’s also used many others, such as the Super Leaf, Penguin Suit, Lucky Bell, Goomba’s Shoe, Frog Suit, Boomerang Flower, and many, many more!
L62:   * When creating the 【34†Super Mario Bros.™ Wonder】 game, veteran game developers Shiro Mouri (director for the game) and Koichi Hayashida (game designer) held an idea-sharing session to source and prototype gameplay elements that would surprise and delight players. Everyone from programmers to sound designers joined to jot down gameplay ideas on sticky notes, regardless of whether it was related to their field of expertise. In all, over 2,000 sticky notes were collected and prototyped on the spot!
L63: If those facts got you fired up to start adventuring alongside Mario, you can click on the link below to see some of the games featuring our versatile hero. And if you really wanna kick it like it’s 1985, 【5†Nintendo Switch Online】 members* can play some of Mario’s early adventures with 【35†Nintendo Classics】 software!
L64: 
L65: 【36†Games Shown:†www.esrb.org】
L66: 
L67: * * *
L68: *Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. 【37†nintendo.com/purchase-terms/】
